description: This source file implements a device communication watchdog that monitors devices' communication status, manages timeouts, and triggers callbacks on communication failure or restoration. It includes thread management, property event handling, and device state tracking.

methods.name: deviceCommunicationWatchdogInit
methods.description: Initializes the watchdog, sets callback functions, creates monitoring thread, and registers property event listener.

methods.name: deviceCommunicationWatchdogSetMonitorInterval
methods.description: Sets the sleep interval for the monitoring thread.

methods.name: deviceCommunicationWatchdogTerm
methods.description: Terminates the watchdog, stops monitoring thread, and cleans up resources.

methods.name: deviceCommunicationWatchdogMonitorDevice
methods.description: Starts monitoring a specific device with given timeout and initial state.

methods.name: deviceCommunicationWatchdogPetDevice
methods.description: Updates the last successful communication time for a device, indicating it is active.

methods.name: deviceCommunicationWatchdogForceDeviceInCommFail
methods.description: Forces a device into communication failure state and triggers callback.

methods.name: deviceCommunicationWatchdogGetRemainingCommFailTimeoutForLPM
methods.description: Calculates remaining time before a device enters communication failure state.

methods.name: deviceCommunicationWatchdogResetTimeoutForDevice
methods.description: Resets the communication failure timeout for a device.
